turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey! How are you feeling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty relaxed today.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat yowls at four in the morning. Every morning. I'm losing my mind.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That sounds rough. Cats are naturally most active around dawn, and she's probably learned that yowling gets you up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, ugh, I left my book on the train this morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh no, that's the worst. Were you near the end?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Like forty pages from the end.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Painful. Do you want to buy a new copy, or wait and see if lost property has it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Quick question for you—

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, Moshi, Emma needs me. I'll let you know when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you back from the gym?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yep, just got in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Emma, are we out of dish soap?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Almost. There's maybe one more load in the bottle.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, adding it to the list. Anything else you need from the store?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oat milk, and those crackers I like.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The rosemary ones?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yes, those. Get two boxes if they're on sale.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back. Floor's yours.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your book on the train. Buying a new copy, or waiting on lost property?
